dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) v02 — Listed Building polygons
evidence_slice: Historic England's official NHLE v02 Listed Building polygons layer is an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer with ListEntry, Name, Grade, CaptureScale and area_ha fields. Official metadata states area_ha is populated where the building footprint has been mapped. The official NHLE entry for List Entry 1306502 identifies Bridge Inn, Bridge Hill, Topsham, Exeter, Devon, EX3 0QQ, Grade II, with most recent amendment 07-Jun-2022, providing explicit inn building type/use evidence. The selected exact layer-3 query for ListEntry=1306502 was not retrievable through the available web channel, and direct DNS resolution for services-eu1.arcgis.com failed before any GeoJSON feature or polygon coordinates could be read.

field_evidence.footprint: Official layer metadata identifies layer 3 as esriGeometryPolygon and states area_ha is populated where the building footprint has been mapped; exact ListEntry 1306502 polygon coordinates were not retrievable.
